The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 03011 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 1 November - the folder's feast day. Captioned Kosma and Damian and filed under Category:Icons of Cosmas and Damian; 1 November is the pair of unmercenaries from Asia, whom the day's line commemorates jointly, so the joint plate is this folder's own hero. Their Roman namesakes keep 1 July and the Arabian pair 17 October. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
